summary: 3 film announcements, 6 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
film.announcement: First trailer released for Michael B. Jordan's reimagining of the classic heist film, with Jordan both directing and starring as the lead.

film.title: Fruit Fly
film.announcement: A24 has optioned Josh Silver's debut adult novel 'Fruit Fly' for television adaptation.

film.title: The Master and Margarita
film.announcement: The long-awaited U.S. theatrical release for the adaptation has been secured following a legal battle.

tv.title: Young Sherlock
tv.talent: Sophie Skelton, Indira Varma, Olivia Williams, Aidan Gillen (new cast additions)
tv.announcement: Season 2 casting announced with Sophie Skelton, Indira Varma, Olivia Williams and Aidan Gillen joining the cast, with returning cast details also revealed.

tv.title: American Idol
tv.announcement: American Idol renewed for Season 25 at ABC with auditions set to kick off in August.

tv.title: Robin Hood
tv.announcement: Graeme Thomas King has been upped to series regular for Season 2, playing Prince John.

tv.title: Thunder Road
tv.announcement: AMC's NASCAR series casts 'Silo' star Shane McRae in a key role.

tv.title: Pinotphile
tv.announcement: Irish comedian Joanne McNally has inked a Netflix deal for her debut hour special 'Pinotphile'.

tv.title: Best in Class
tv.announcement: Comcast's Xfinity is launching a creator reality series 'Best in Class' hosted by Katie Feeney targeting creators and influencers.
